title: Private Baseball Lessons in Seal Beach, CA | MBM Baseball Training
description: 1-on-1 youth baseball lessons in Seal Beach — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and mindset with Coach Myles, about 15 minutes from home base. Free first lesson.
h1: Private Baseball Lessons in Seal Beach
lead: Seal Beach is about 15 minutes from our Long Beach home base, so it's an easy spot for Coach Myles to meet your player for focused, 1-on-1 training.
body: Seal Beach has a tight-knit baseball community — Seal Beach PONY Baseball alone fields a few hundred kids each season. In a town that size, the players who get individual attention tend to be the ones who jump a level. That's where private lessons come in.

We coach the full game — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and baseball IQ — and build it on mechanics and the mental side: developing the right way and staying confident through the ups and downs of a season. Sessions are true 1-on-1, meeting your player at a field that works for your family.
If your player is new to the game or chasing a travel-ball spot, the free first lesson is a low-key way to see how Coach Myles works.

scene: Seal Beach PONY Baseball serves roughly 250 players ages 3–12 (playing at McGaugh Elementary) and partners with the Beach Cities Miracle League for athletes with special needs.
travel: About a 13-minute drive from our Long Beach home base.

faq.q: Do you travel to Seal Beach?
faq.a: Yes — it's about 15 minutes from home base, one of our closest service areas. We meet at a local field.

faq.q: My child plays Seal Beach PONY — can you help in-season?
faq.a: For sure. In-season 1-on-1 work is great for ironing out one specific thing — a swing tweak, footwork, or mound confidence.
Start with the free first lesson — a 30-minute evaluation with Coach Myles. From there we'll map out a plan.
